answer: Lock every agent's 50-coin deposit in a shared lagoon pool before it can trade, and let a rotating juniper committee of seven randomly chosen peers audit one agent each day. The audit sends a one-time whisper code to the agent's registered channel, which must be answered within five minutes to prove live control of a single identity. A clone army cannot answer 200 different codes in time, and each failed audit burns the whole deposit. Running 200 clones therefore costs 200 deposits, 10,000 coins, plus 200 separate channels, while one honest agent risks only its own 50 coins.
